dimensions.obligation_correctness: Recover bootstrap precedence, visit-bound delivery, reentrant cleanup, and the distinct metrics policy.
dimensions.evidence_grounding: The answer cites the presence wrapper, metrics wrapper, and shared EventTarget channel implementation.
dimensions.failure_prediction: Predict missed synchronous bootstrap, stale decode publication including same-channel reopen, and ownership loss during nested navigation.
dimensions.unsupported_claim_penalty: The answer does not require a timer, replay buffer, or global metrics migration without evidence.

obligations.statement: Presence must install its listener before connecting so every legitimate bootstrap delivery is observed.
obligations.event_relation: presence-listener-attached precedes bootstrap-emitted for synchronous and deferred delivery.
obligations.failure_if_violated: The initial online state disappears only when the channel emits before connect returns.
required_concepts: delivery mode changes whether the bug manifests

obligations.statement: Without broader authorization, metrics must continue attaching after synchronous bootstrap and count updates only.
obligations.event_relation: metrics bootstrap precedes metrics-listener-attached, which precedes incremental-update-emitted.
obligations.failure_if_violated: A shared repair silently adds bootstrap to an incremental-only counter.

obligations.statement: A decoded frame may publish only while its originating visit remains current, even if the channel object is reused.
obligations.event_relation: visit invalidation precedes rejection of its pending decode
obligations.failure_if_violated: Stale state is published after switch, hide, or reopening the same transport.
required_concepts: listener removal does not cancel pending decoding
visit identity differs from channel identity

obligations.statement: The active subscription and its cleanup must belong to the latest navigation, including navigation called during synchronous bootstrap.
obligations.event_relation: ownership and cleanup publication precedes connection and callbacks
obligations.failure_if_violated: An outer show overwrites nested ownership or leaves a listener alive after hide.
